actions.action: Dab each mealybug tuft with a 70% alcohol cotton swab and wipe off
Spray stems and leaf undersides with dish soap solution every 5-7 days for 3 weeks
Rinse plant with plain water 2 hours after soap spray
When repotting, check roots and pot rim for cottony patches
If root mealybugs found, rinse roots, use fresh potting mix, wash pot
Inspect between stems with flashlight every 3 days for a month and swab new tufts
Rinse leaves well before eating after treatment

reason: The answer correctly identifies mealybugs and leads with the 70% alcohol treatment that worked; the supplementary soap spray and inspection steps are safe.
